messages:
maria: Heads-up — HF -> Redwood convert for clairvoy-7B produced a tokenizer with conflicting special token ids; generation gets cut off mid-sentence in replay tests.

aj: Oof. Can you paste the tokenizer/config bits and any convert logs?

maria: sure, small excerpt:
```json
{
  "bos_token": "<s>",
  "eos_token": "</s>",
  "pad_token": "<pad>",
  "unk_token": "<unk>",
  "bos_token_id": 1,
  "eos_token_id": 2,
  "pad_token_id": 2
}
```
pad_token_id == eos_token_id (2). That explains truncated outputs when padding appears.

sachin: how did pad become same as eos? Was this from HF tokenizer metadata or our remapping in convert step?

maria: convertbot logs show a shard fetch 403 during hub download right before writing tokenizer.json, then a retry that used a cached index. snippets: 
```
convertbot INFO download shard 3 url=...shard-3.safetensors
convertbot WARN download failed 403 retrying
convertbot WARN fallback: using cached index (partial)
convertbot INFO wrote tokenizer.json -> bos=1 eos=2 pad=2
```

aj: so a partial index + fallback could have caused token id remapping to be inconsistent. If a shard with vocab diffs failed, cached index merge might have produced duplicate ids.

emily: I can repro locally by blocking shard 3 during the hf hub fetch and running `rw-convert --model clairvoy-7B --out tmp/`. The tokenizer produced identical result. I'll push a repro gist.

convertbot: convertbot: convert finished (exit 0) artifacts: gs://rw-convert/clairvoy-7B/2026-03-19-23-21/ (metadata: rev: unknown, source: hub fallback)

sachin: another angle: our quantization stage reorders vocab->id mapping if it sees inconsistent shard ordering; weight key renames shouldn't touch tokenizer but converter merges tokenmaps when index incomplete. We should assert uniqueness before finishing.

maria: eval numbers: automated chat eval shows -12% response length and BLEU drop ~9. Manual check: model emits `<pad>` tokens in middle then immediately hits eos id so chat ends.

aj: mitigation steps? rollback catalog entry, re-import pinned revision after fixing hub auth, and add assertion.

emily: filed GH issue: rw/convert#1428 with reproducer and logs. Assigning to @sachin for fix of fallback logic.

ops-bot: ops-bot: notice — service token hf-infra-service rotated at 2026-03-19T23:18:07Z; some hub requests returned 403 during that window.

sachin: confirmed — fallback behavior currently treats 403 like transient and continues with partial index. I'll change it to fail hard on auth errors and surface the partial state. Also will add a post-merge assert: set(tokenizer_special_token_ids) length == number_of_special_tokens.

aj: I'll add a unit test in convert integration tests that blocks a shard to ensure convert fails, not silently succeeds.

maria: plan: 1) revert clairvoy-7B entry in model catalog (temporary) 2) convertbot: fail-on-403 change + unit test (sachin) 3) add tokenizer uniqueness assert (aj) 4) re-run import with explicit --rev-pin after creds confirmed (maria/emily) 5) re-run evals and publish results.

emily: taking the re-import and re-eval step after patch lands.

maria: thanks — priority P2 for regression. Please add any findings to the GH issue and link catalog rollback PR.

aj: noted, I'll queue infra test in tonight's pipeline. :thumbsup:

sachin: starting a patch now, will post diff shortly.

maria: ping me when ready, I'll coordinate the rollback and notify customers who pulled the model.

(very short thread, moving to GH for detailed diffs)
